title: Site clip from the site's own assets
description: A short clip for the Lampway site (a teaser, a feature loop, a social cut) made only from the site's public folder: logo, mark, palette tokens, self-hosted type, copy and approved media. The spike's teaser is this template's first output.

body.subject: Lampway, told with the site's own material: the mark and lockup from {{logo_dir}}, the copy quoted verbatim from {{copy_source}}, the media in {{media_dir}}; {{focus}}.
body.action: The beats below, in order: the mark draws stroke by stroke, the headline lines arrive one at a time, each feature holds long enough to read its line (at least {{read_s}} s), the end card holds the lockup and one call to action.
body.camera: A fixed 2D frame; motion comes from layers sliding, fading and drawing on, never from a moving virtual camera. One move per layer at a time.
body.style: Night surface (the site's .night tokens), one flame accent, the site's serif for headlines and its sans and mono for the rest, the site's own lamp-lit treatment for figures; {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image and reports each one, window.__frame(t) that sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone, and window.__audit() that lists the visible text with its box, size and colour. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Quote the site's copy and status words exactly (Built, Live, Partial, Design, in progress); add no claim the site does not make. Frame 0 shows a mark, never an empty frame.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

logo_dir.description: the site's logo SVGs and fonts

copy_source.description: the page the copy is quoted from

focus.default: who holds the keys, then three features, then build it from source

read_s.description: minimum hold for one line of copy

image_references.description: approved site media to place (figures, UI shots)

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)

provenance.source: captain 2026-10-07: motion graphics from code ('add it to the list'); the scene contract and gates measured in the spike (the spike REPORT; receipts in scratch/motion/out/lampway-teaser/)

beats.action: the mark draws, the flame lights, the wordmark follows
the headline, then one line of supporting copy, beside the lit figure
three features, one card each, status word above the line
end card: lockup, the status line, one call to action, held
